content: If Can NmPnEnabled is TRUE and a NM - PDU has to be transmitted (either as cylic NM - PDU transmitted with CanNmMsgCycleTime (see [SWS_CanNm_00512 ) or as PN shutdown message), the CanNm module shall additionally fetch the PNC bit vector by calling Nm_PncBitVectorTxIndication and copy the PNC bit vector with respect to NmPncBitVectorOffset and NmPncBitVectorLength of the corresponding NM - channel to the NM - PDU before requesting the transmission of the NM - PDU .
